name: CardAuthorisation
description: Immutable record of a single card authorisation request and its outcome. Created by SVC-011 at the point an authorisation request is received from the card network (PH-041, JRN-011). Updated in PH-042 with the decision outcome and processing_time_ms. The raw PAN is tokenised on ingress to SVC-011; card_number_token is the only card identifier stored on this entity. This entity is the primary audit record for PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.2 (audit log of cardholder data access) and for Visa/Mastercard chargeback dispute resolution. The processed_time_ms field enforces the card network 500ms SLA constraint.

fields.name: auth_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-011. Immutable. Correlation key for EVT-064, EVT-065, EVT-066, EVT-067.

fields.name: card_number_token
fields.validation_rule: Required. Format-preserving token (16 digits, BIN preserved). Never the raw PAN. Immutable.
fields.pci_note: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5.1 — PAN must be protected. card_number_token is the ONLY form stored on this entity and in all event payloads. Raw PAN handled only within SVC-011 PCI CDE at ingress tokenisation.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Immutable.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id (ENT-004) for debit cards, or FK → CreditCardAccount.account_id (ENT-023) for credit cards.

fields.name: card_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: debit | credit.

fields.name: merchant_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. Visa/Mastercard Merchant ID (MID). Max 15 chars.

fields.name: merchant_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 25 chars (ISO 8583 Field 43 format).

fields.name: merchant_category_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 18245 MCC. 4-digit numeric.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Transaction amount in transaction currency. Positive, non-zero. Max 2 dp.

fields.name: currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217. 3 chars.

fields.name: billing_amount_gbp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required if currency != GBP. GBP equivalent at scheme FX rate at authorisation time. Null if currency = GBP.

fields.name: auth_code
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. 6-char alphanumeric. Non-null only if status = approved. Generated by SVC-011 on approval.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending_decision | approved | declined | referred. Transitions: pending_decision (PH-041) → approved | declined | referred (PH-042).

fields.name: decline_reason
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required if status = declined. Enum: insufficient_funds | credit_limit_exceeded | card_blocked_lost | card_blocked_stolen | card_suspended | fraud_rule_triggered | expired_card | invalid_pin | sca_failure | do_not_honour. INTERNAL USE ONLY — never in external API responses or event payloads.
fields.pci_note: Must not be surfaced in event payloads (card testing attack prevention). Logged to WORM audit pipeline via SVC-103 direct access to ENT-032 within PCI CDE.

fields.name: scheme_response_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8583 Field 39 action code. 2-digit string. External-facing decline code returned to card network.

fields.name: transaction_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: card_present | card_not_present | contactless | atm_withdrawal | recurring.

fields.name: three_ds_result
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required for card_not_present. Enum: authenticated | attempted | not_authenticated | not_required | not_applicable. Null for card_present and atm_withdrawal.

fields.name: sca_exemption_applied
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Enum: low_value_contactless | recurring_transaction | transaction_risk_analysis | merchant_initiated | null. Recorded for FCA SCA compliance audit.

fields.name: processing_time_ms
fields.validation_rule: Required. Milliseconds from request receipt to response transmission. Must be > 0. Alert if > 400ms. Hard SLA: < 500ms.

fields.name: channel_country_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Country of merchant/ATM.

fields.name: authorised_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of authorisation decision. Immutable.

fields.name: request_received_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of receipt of the authorisation request from the card network.

relationships.description: CardAuthorisation belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK.
CardAuthorisation references one Account (debit card) via account_id FK.
CardAuthorisation references one CreditCardAccount (credit card) via account_id FK.
An approved CardAuthorisation may have one CardSettlement in PH-045. Relationship optional (some auths expire without settlement).

design_decisions.decision: card_number_token is the ONLY card identifier on CardAuthorisation. Raw PAN is not persisted.
design_decisions.rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5.1. Consistent with DD-ENT023-01 on CreditCardAccount. SVC-011 tokenises the raw PAN on ingress from the card scheme network; all subsequent processing uses card_number_token.

design_decisions.decision: processing_time_ms is stored at authorisation time — not computed at query time.
design_decisions.rationale: SLA compliance evidence for Visa/Mastercard scheme rules and NFR-JRN011-001. Immutable at the time of the event to create a tamper-evident record of actual processing time.

design_decisions.decision: decline_reason is stored on ENT-032 for internal audit but never surfaced in external API responses or event payloads.
design_decisions.rationale: Merchant and card network receive only scheme_response_code. Specific internal decline reasons could enable card testing attacks. Internal audit trail (via SVC-103 direct access within PCI CDE) retains the full reason.
